qa.desktop_browser: V43 loaded fresh over HTTPS. Click-tested main navigation, assistant, two consecutive local prompts and web service details. Last answer remains in conversation, the page does not jump on input focus. No browser console error messages during tested flow.

Card price/Pago único and details CTA render in one row; section headings/cards have consistent breathing room; Info y más, notification bell and empty state fit; assistant entry, sample prompt, reply and composer visible at 320. qa.icons: Nine V7 SVGs parse; default strokes #E9E8E6; a single quiet accent per service family. Page uses existing S wordmark; the original S path was preserved from previous version.
qa.assets: 29 local page references collected from live HTML, all returned HTTP 200; the new V7 icon family and V43 CSS/JS assets also return HTTP 200.
qa.console: No browser console error messages in V43 navigation, chat, modal or Info & más checks.
qa.physical_keyboard: Not tested with a physical phone or its native soft keyboard. VisualViewport keyboard behavior is coded, but needs device QA.
qa.production: Not changed. Production migration still requires Cristian’s explicit approval and separate release/real integration QA.

note: The local chat still gives rule-based demo recommendations only; it does not monitor live business state or activate actions.
